issue.title: Http Backlog

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Label used to distinguish feature request from other issues

issue.body:
Prioritized list of features and issues to take care of relating to the `Http` library.
## Closed
- [x] #2816 _chore(http): add XMLHttpRequest as type on XHRConnection_
- [x] #2810 _feat(http): simple, dynamic retrying of failed requests_
## Implemented
- [x] #2564 _refactor(Http): remove HttpFactory_
- [x] #2415 _feat(http): EventEmitter and Dart support_
- [x] #2818 _feat(http): add JsonP and JsonPBackend_
- [x] #2680 _refactor(http): move http into its own module as sibling of angular2_
- [x] #3365 _fix(http): cannot use jsonpInjectables and httpInjectables in same injector_
- [x] #2417 _feat(http): implement support for headers and url params objects in http_
- [x] #2635 _http should complete after response_
- [x] #2904 _chore(http): convert RequestMethods to const list_
- [x] #3110 _feat(Observable): swap underlying RxJS implementation used by EventEmitter with RxJS-Next_ (Blocked by RxJS alpha release)
- [x] #3339 _chore(http): remove unused properties from Request and Response_
- [x] #2788 _Http class requires `@Inject` decorator to be injected when using TypeScript_
- [x] #4245 _fix(http): should throw an exception if input to `http.request` is not string or `Request`_
- [x] #2800 _feat(http): implement error propagation in XHRBackend_
- [x] #4043 _Http requests should be lazy / cold Observables_
- [x] #2840 _feat(http): accept string for method in RequestOptions class and interface_
- [x] #2794 @robwormald  M38  _feat(http): directly return RxJS Observable or Dart Stream from Http 
  methods_
- [x] #4588 _Fix async pipe so it works with Http / proper Observables_
- [x] #5015 Fix Connection.response typedef to Observable<Response>
## Blocked
- [ ] #2684 Needs design _RFC: Http interceptors and transformers_
- [ ] #2822 Needs design _feat(http): helpers/guides for short polling_
- [ ] Security features (No issue yet, needs design)
## In Progress/Current Milestone
## Ready to Implement

Ordered roughly by a factor of priority & level of effort
- [ ] #2554 _refactor(http): move mock_backend to test_lib module_
- [ ] #4472 _refactor(http): convert Connection interface to be Observable of Response_
- [ ] #4231 _feat(http): add support for withCredentials_
- [ ] #2897 _feat(http): support use by AngularJS 1.x applications_
- [ ] #2806 _chore(http): assert that url is present in RequestOptions when creating a Request_
- [ ] #2609 _perf(http): Provide means to optimize response parsing_
- [ ] #2803 _feat(http): Support many types of body on Request/Response and all ConnectionBackend implementations_
- [ ] #2903 _feat(http): automatically set request Content-Type header based on body type_
- [ ] #2812 _feat(http): add timeout support to `Request`_
- [ ] #2795 _feat(http): implement streaming upload/download_
- [ ] #2799 _refactor(http): only use readyState in mock connection_
- [ ] #3513 _refactor(http): rename URLSearchParams to something else_
